description: This file defines the JPA entity class 'Label' representing user-defined labels (similar to Gmail labels) within the email application. It includes fields for label ID, owner, name, color, creation time, and update time, along with relevant database mappings and lifecycle hooks.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: JPA entity representing a user-defined email label with fields for ID, owner, name, color, and timestamps, including lifecycle hooks for creation and updating.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Returns the owner (User) of the label.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner (User) of the label.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the label's color in hex string.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the label was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the label was last updated.
